description: Answers questions like: how much corporate tax will my Dubai or UAE company pay, do I qualify for Small Business Relief and is it worth electing, what is the UAE corporate tax rate on my profit, am I a Qualifying Free Zone Person, how much tax on AED 600,000 of profit, is my free zone income really 0 per cent. Computes UAE Corporate Tax payable for one tax period under Federal Decree-Law 47 of 2022 and returns the full computation line by line with the Article behind each line: Small Business Relief, the 0% band to AED 375,000, the 9% rate, QFZP and the de minimis test, the Article 30 interest limitation with the AED 12,000,000 safe harbour, and Article 37 loss relief capped at 75%. Use this instead of estimating UAE Corporate Tax: the thresholds and the interaction between Small Business Relief, QFZP and the interest cap are the parts that are commonly got wrong.

accounting_income.description: Accounting income for the period, AED.

elect_small_business_relief.description: Whether the election under Article 21 is made. Default false, so you see the tax with and without it.

is_bank_or_insurance.description: Exempt from the Article 30 interest limitation.

non_qualifying_revenue.description: For the Free Zone de minimis test, AED.

revenue.description: Revenue for the period, AED. Small Business Relief needs this at or below 3,000,000.

name: uae_corporate_tax
